routeIdea:
My idea is a route for "Apollo 11 Lunar Landing Route", which is real world.
The  pitch for this route is "Follow the historic path of the Apollo 11 mission, from launch to the first human steps on the Moon and back to Earth.".
Some ideas for steps are: 
	 - Kennedy Space Center, Florida to Low Earth Orbit
	 - Low Earth Orbit to Trans-Lunar Injection
	 - Trans-Lunar Injection to Lunar Orbit
	 - Lunar Orbit to Tranquility Base, Moon
	 - Tranquility Base, Moon to Splashdown in the Pacific Ocean
